prompt: A client sends GET user:42 to node 7000, which answers MOVED 4813 127.0.0.1:7001. What should a well-behaved client do?
explanation: MOVED says the slot 4813 now belongs permanently to the node at 127.0.0.1:7001. Smart clients resend the command there and remember the slot-to-node mapping so later keys in that slot go straight to the right node.

options.text: Resend the command to 127.0.0.1:7001 and remember that slot 4813 lives there
Retry the same node after a short delay, since MOVED is a transient error
Send ASKING to node 7000 and retry there
Drop the key and recreate it on the node the client thinks owns the slot
